description: All operatives treat visibility as Obscured beyond 10″. Worsen WS by 1 of Ranged attacks beyond 6″.
At the start of each Turning Point, roll 1D. On a4, a random operative within the mist zone suffers1D3 wound.
At the end of each operative’s activation, roll 1D6. On a 4+, the operative is pushed 2 inch in a random direction.
Operatives cannot perform the dash action.
Operatives roll 1d6 + APL on a 6+ halve that operatives movement.
This Zone isn't affected by mist, Ranged attacks within or that target an operative in mist still apply mist effects.
Operatives movement is reduced by 1 inch.
Roll 1D3, at the beginning of turning point result place 1D3 Force of nature Creatures. They activate after all operatives.
Operatives in the mist zone cannot use Silent or Conceal abilities.
Operatives in the mist zone cannot be targeted by ranged attacks beyond 12 inch.
At the beggining of turning point all operatives roll 1D6, on a 1 loses 1 AP. Roll 1D6 + APL at the end of activation.
All operatives treat visibility as Obscured beyond 6 inch. Worsen WS by 1 of Ranged attacks.
PSYCHIC abilities gain +1 to hit but inflict 1 wound on the user if they fail the roll.
